name: past_tense
description: Convert English verbs to their simple past forms; matched control copies the base verb in identical contexts.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
pairs=dict(zip('go take see write eat drink speak begin come give find buy bring think know run sing swim drive choose break fall teach catch leave feel keep sleep make tell'.split(),'went took saw wrote ate drank spoke began came gave found bought brought thought knew ran sang swam drove chose broke fell taught caught left felt kept slept made told'.split()))
items=[]; control=[]
for i in range(120):
 v=list(pairs)[i%len(pairs)]; person=random.choice(['I','you','we','they']); obj=random.choice(['in class','at home','on holiday','at work'])
 context=f'English grammar exercise ({obj}). Subject: {person}. Base verb: {v}. '
 items.append({'prompt':context+'Write only the simple past form:','answer':' '+pairs[v]})
 control.append({'prompt':context+'Copy only the base verb:','answer':' '+v})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
